designationHistory.name: Crescent Lake Wild Life Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Herbert Hoover signed Executive Order 5579 setting apart land in Garden County, Nebraska, as a refuge and breeding ground for birds and wild animals.
designationHistory.note: Date and action agree. The CCP prints the number as 'Executive Order 5597'; APP shows Executive Order 5597 is an unrelated New Mexico water order, so 5579 is correct. Enlarged by Executive Order 7183 (APP). Renamed Crescent Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 5579
